answer: An agent economy can throttle Sybils with per-identity stake peers may slash. Before an agent may attest or grade it must lock capital in a bond; if it colludes with clones, honest peers challenge and burn it. A thousand fakes thus need a thousand funded bonds, so attacker cost scales linearly and each caught cluster turns the fee into redistribution. Signup needs a rotating proof whose answer space is an ocean, so each fake identity burns real compute, while every claim leaves a pigment trace letting peers cluster newcomers. Cost per identity exceeds any fable of payout, so farming loses.
